stemMd: A mountain village had fewer overnight visitors this season but more visitor-nights. Which is the best explanation?

options.label: C
options.textMd: Visitors stayed long enough on average to outweigh the decline in their number.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The village opened a new souvenir shop.

explanationMd: Visitor-nights multiply the number of visitors by the average stay. Fewer visitors can generate more visitor-nights if stays become sufficiently longer. Do not confuse people with the accumulated number of nights they spend.

distractorRationale.b: Room size does not determine visitor-nights.
distractorRationale.a: Day visitors do not contribute overnight stays.
distractorRationale.e: A shop does not establish stay duration.
distractorRationale.d: Transport mode does not explain the two totals.
